definitions.name: Baserow List Workspaces (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
GET {endpoint}/api/workspaces/. Authentication: user JWT only; provider permissions apply. One request only. next/previous URLs are return-only metadata; choose page/size explicitly. No sign-in, token refresh, automatic retries, attachment downloads, webhooks or background listeners. Exact decimal text remains text; noninteger/unsafe JSON numeric tokens become exact source strings. Total deadline starts before profile/secret access; limits 200 rows per page/batch, 1 MiB response, 16384 nonempty chunks, 512 KiB request, depth 35. Known resource projection omits unsupported provider fields. Sources: https://baserow.io/docs/apis/rest-api https://api.baserow.io/api/schema.json https://api.baserow.io/api/redoc/ https://baserow.io/user-docs/database-api

definitions.name: Baserow Create Workspace (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
POST {endpoint}/api/workspaces/. Authentication: user JWT only; provider permissions apply. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="BASEROW CREATE-WORKSPACE", and $retries=0. One request only. next/previous URLs are return-only metadata; choose page/size explicitly. No sign-in, token refresh, automatic retries, attachment downloads, webhooks or background listeners. Exact decimal text remains text; noninteger/unsafe JSON numeric tokens become exact source strings. Total deadline starts before profile/secret access; limits 200 rows per page/batch, 1 MiB response, 16384 nonempty chunks, 512 KiB request, depth 35. Known resource projection omits unsupported provider fields. Sources: https://baserow.io/docs/apis/rest-api https://api.baserow.io/api/schema.json https://api.baserow.io/api/redoc/ https://baserow.io/user-docs/database-api

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Baserow List Applications (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
GET {endpoint}/api/applications/. Authentication: user JWT only; provider permissions apply. One request only. next/previous URLs are return-only metadata; choose page/size explicitly. No sign-in, token refresh, automatic retries, attachment downloads, webhooks or background listeners. Exact decimal text remains text; noninteger/unsafe JSON numeric tokens become exact source strings. Total deadline starts before profile/secret access; limits 200 rows per page/batch, 1 MiB response, 16384 nonempty chunks, 512 KiB request, depth 35. Known resource projection omits unsupported provider fields. Sources: https://baserow.io/docs/apis/rest-api https://api.baserow.io/api/schema.json https://api.baserow.io/api/redoc/ https://baserow.io/user-docs/database-api

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

endpoint.description: Required HTTPS origin, for example https://api.baserow.io; self-hosted HTTPS origins supported.

definitions.name: Baserow List Workspace Applications (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
GET {endpoint}/api/applications/workspace/{workspaceId}/. Authentication: user JWT only; provider permissions apply. One request only. next/previous URLs are return-only metadata; choose page/size explicitly. No sign-in, token refresh, automatic retries, attachment downloads, webhooks or background listeners. Exact decimal text remains text; noninteger/unsafe JSON numeric tokens become exact source strings. Total deadline starts before profile/secret access; limits 200 rows per page/batch, 1 MiB response, 16384 nonempty chunks, 512 KiB request, depth 35. Known resource projection omits unsupported provider fields. Sources: https://baserow.io/docs/apis/rest-api https://api.baserow.io/api/schema.json https://api.baserow.io/api/redoc/ https://baserow.io/user-docs/database-api

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

endpoint.description: Required HTTPS origin, for example https://api.baserow.io; self-hosted HTTPS origins supported.

definitions.name: Baserow Update Application (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
PATCH {endpoint}/api/applications/{applicationId}/. Authentication: user JWT only; provider permissions apply. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="BASEROW UPDATE-APPLICATION", and $retries=0. One request only. next/previous URLs are return-only metadata; choose page/size explicitly. No sign-in, token refresh, automatic retries, attachment downloads, webhooks or background listeners. Exact decimal text remains text; noninteger/unsafe JSON numeric tokens become exact source strings. Total deadline starts before profile/secret access; limits 200 rows per page/batch, 1 MiB response, 16384 nonempty chunks, 512 KiB request, depth 35. Known resource projection omits unsupported provider fields. Sources: https://baserow.io/docs/apis/rest-api https://api.baserow.io/api/schema.json https://api.baserow.io/api/redoc/ https://baserow.io/user-docs/database-api

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

endpoint.description: Required HTTPS origin, for example https://api.baserow.io; self-hosted HTTPS origins supported.

definitions.name: Baserow Delete Application (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
DELETE {endpoint}/api/applications/{applicationId}/. Authentication: user JWT only; provider permissions apply. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="BASEROW DELETE-APPLICATION", and $retries=0. One request only. next/previous URLs are return-only metadata; choose page/size explicitly. No sign-in, token refresh, automatic retries, attachment downloads, webhooks or background listeners. Exact decimal text remains text; noninteger/unsafe JSON numeric tokens become exact source strings. Total deadline starts before profile/secret access; limits 200 rows per page/batch, 1 MiB response, 16384 nonempty chunks, 512 KiB request, depth 35. Known resource projection omits unsupported provider fields. Sources: https://baserow.io/docs/apis/rest-api https://api.baserow.io/api/schema.json https://api.baserow.io/api/redoc/ https://baserow.io/user-docs/database-api

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Baserow Get Table (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
GET {endpoint}/api/database/tables/{tableId}/. Authentication: user JWT only; provider permissions apply. One request only. next/previous URLs are return-only metadata; choose page/size explicitly. No sign-in, token refresh, automatic retries, attachment downloads, webhooks or background listeners. Exact decimal text remains text; noninteger/unsafe JSON numeric tokens become exact source strings. Total deadline starts before profile/secret access; limits 200 rows per page/batch, 1 MiB response, 16384 nonempty chunks, 512 KiB request, depth 35. Known resource projection omits unsupported provider fields. Sources: https://baserow.io/docs/apis/rest-api https://api.baserow.io/api/schema.json https://api.baserow.io/api/redoc/ https://baserow.io/user-docs/database-api

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

endpoint.description: Required HTTPS origin, for example https://api.baserow.io; self-hosted HTTPS origins supported.

definitions.documentation:
POST {endpoint}/api/database/tables/database/{databaseId}/. Authentication: user JWT only; provider permissions apply. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="BASEROW CREATE-TABLE", and $retries=0. One request only. next/previous URLs are return-only metadata; choose page/size explicitly. No sign-in, token refresh, automatic retries, attachment downloads, webhooks or background listeners. Exact decimal text remains text; noninteger/unsafe JSON numeric tokens become exact source strings. Total deadline starts before profile/secret access; limits 200 rows per page/batch, 1 MiB response, 16384 nonempty chunks, 512 KiB request, depth 35. Known resource projection omits unsupported provider fields. Sources: https://baserow.io/docs/apis/rest-api https://api.baserow.io/api/schema.json https://api.baserow.io/api/redoc/ https://baserow.io/user-docs/database-api

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

endpoint.description: Required HTTPS origin, for example https://api.baserow.io; self-hosted HTTPS origins supported.

definitions.name: Baserow Order Tables (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
POST {endpoint}/api/database/tables/database/{databaseId}/order/. Authentication: user JWT only; provider permissions apply. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="BASEROW ORDER-TABLES", and $retries=0. One request only. next/previous URLs are return-only metadata; choose page/size explicitly. No sign-in, token refresh, automatic retries, attachment downloads, webhooks or background listeners. Exact decimal text remains text; noninteger/unsafe JSON numeric tokens become exact source strings. Total deadline starts before profile/secret access; limits 200 rows per page/batch, 1 MiB response, 16384 nonempty chunks, 512 KiB request, depth 35. Known resource projection omits unsupported provider fields. Sources: https://baserow.io/docs/apis/rest-api https://api.baserow.io/api/schema.json https://api.baserow.io/api/redoc/ https://baserow.io/user-docs/database-api

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

endpoint.description: Required HTTPS origin, for example https://api.baserow.io; self-hosted HTTPS origins supported.

definitions.name: Baserow List Fields (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
GET {endpoint}/api/database/fields/table/{tableId}/. Authentication: database Token or user JWT; provider permissions apply. One request only. next/previous URLs are return-only metadata; choose page/size explicitly. No sign-in, token refresh, automatic retries, attachment downloads, webhooks or background listeners. Exact decimal text remains text; noninteger/unsafe JSON numeric tokens become exact source strings. Total deadline starts before profile/secret access; limits 200 rows per page/batch, 1 MiB response, 16384 nonempty chunks, 512 KiB request, depth 35. Known resource projection omits unsupported provider fields. Sources: https://baserow.io/docs/apis/rest-api https://api.baserow.io/api/schema.json https://api.baserow.io/api/redoc/ https://baserow.io/user-docs/database-api

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

endpoint.description: Required HTTPS origin, for example https://api.baserow.io; self-hosted HTTPS origins supported.

definitions.name: Baserow Update Field (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
PATCH {endpoint}/api/database/fields/{fieldId}/. Authentication: user JWT only; provider permissions apply. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="BASEROW UPDATE-FIELD", and $retries=0. One request only. next/previous URLs are return-only metadata; choose page/size explicitly. No sign-in, token refresh, automatic retries, attachment downloads, webhooks or background listeners. Exact decimal text remains text; noninteger/unsafe JSON numeric tokens become exact source strings. Total deadline starts before profile/secret access; limits 200 rows per page/batch, 1 MiB response, 16384 nonempty chunks, 512 KiB request, depth 35. Known resource projection omits unsupported provider fields. Sources: https://baserow.io/docs/apis/rest-api https://api.baserow.io/api/schema.json https://api.baserow.io/api/redoc/ https://baserow.io/user-docs/database-api

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Baserow Get Row (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
GET {endpoint}/api/database/rows/table/{tableId}/{rowId}/. Authentication: database Token or user JWT; provider permissions apply. One request only. next/previous URLs are return-only metadata; choose page/size explicitly. No sign-in, token refresh, automatic retries, attachment downloads, webhooks or background listeners. Exact decimal text remains text; noninteger/unsafe JSON numeric tokens become exact source strings. Total deadline starts before profile/secret access; limits 200 rows per page/batch, 1 MiB response, 16384 nonempty chunks, 512 KiB request, depth 35. Known resource projection omits unsupported provider fields. Sources: https://baserow.io/docs/apis/rest-api https://api.baserow.io/api/schema.json https://api.baserow.io/api/redoc/ https://baserow.io/user-docs/database-api

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

endpoint.description: Required HTTPS origin, for example https://api.baserow.io; self-hosted HTTPS origins supported.

definitions.name: Baserow Create Row (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
POST {endpoint}/api/database/rows/table/{tableId}/. Authentication: database Token or user JWT; provider permissions apply. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="BASEROW CREATE-ROW", and $retries=0. One request only. next/previous URLs are return-only metadata; choose page/size explicitly. No sign-in, token refresh, automatic retries, attachment downloads, webhooks or background listeners. Exact decimal text remains text; noninteger/unsafe JSON numeric tokens become exact source strings. Total deadline starts before profile/secret access; limits 200 rows per page/batch, 1 MiB response, 16384 nonempty chunks, 512 KiB request, depth 35. Known resource projection omits unsupported provider fields. Sources: https://baserow.io/docs/apis/rest-api https://api.baserow.io/api/schema.json https://api.baserow.io/api/redoc/ https://baserow.io/user-docs/database-api

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

endpoint.description: Required HTTPS origin, for example https://api.baserow.io; self-hosted HTTPS origins supported.

definitions.documentation:
PATCH {endpoint}/api/database/rows/table/{tableId}/{rowId}/. Authentication: database Token or user JWT; provider permissions apply. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="BASEROW UPDATE-ROW", and $retries=0. One request only. next/previous URLs are return-only metadata; choose page/size explicitly. No sign-in, token refresh, automatic retries, attachment downloads, webhooks or background listeners. Exact decimal text remains text; noninteger/unsafe JSON numeric tokens become exact source strings. Total deadline starts before profile/secret access; limits 200 rows per page/batch, 1 MiB response, 16384 nonempty chunks, 512 KiB request, depth 35. Known resource projection omits unsupported provider fields. Sources: https://baserow.io/docs/apis/rest-api https://api.baserow.io/api/schema.json https://api.baserow.io/api/redoc/ https://baserow.io/user-docs/database-api

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.documentation:
DELETE {endpoint}/api/database/rows/table/{tableId}/{rowId}/. Authentication: database Token or user JWT; provider permissions apply. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="BASEROW DELETE-ROW", and $retries=0. One request only. next/previous URLs are return-only metadata; choose page/size explicitly. No sign-in, token refresh, automatic retries, attachment downloads, webhooks or background listeners. Exact decimal text remains text; noninteger/unsafe JSON numeric tokens become exact source strings. Total deadline starts before profile/secret access; limits 200 rows per page/batch, 1 MiB response, 16384 nonempty chunks, 512 KiB request, depth 35. Known resource projection omits unsupported provider fields. Sources: https://baserow.io/docs/apis/rest-api https://api.baserow.io/api/schema.json https://api.baserow.io/api/redoc/ https://baserow.io/user-docs/database-api

definitions.name: Baserow Move Row (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
PATCH {endpoint}/api/database/rows/table/{tableId}/{rowId}/move/. Authentication: database Token or user JWT; provider permissions apply. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="BASEROW MOVE-ROW", and $retries=0. One request only. next/previous URLs are return-only metadata; choose page/size explicitly. No sign-in, token refresh, automatic retries, attachment downloads, webhooks or background listeners. Exact decimal text remains text; noninteger/unsafe JSON numeric tokens become exact source strings. Total deadline starts before profile/secret access; limits 200 rows per page/batch, 1 MiB response, 16384 nonempty chunks, 512 KiB request, depth 35. Known resource projection omits unsupported provider fields. Sources: https://baserow.io/docs/apis/rest-api https://api.baserow.io/api/schema.json https://api.baserow.io/api/redoc/ https://baserow.io/user-docs/database-api

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.documentation:
POST {endpoint}/api/database/rows/table/{tableId}/batch/. Authentication: database Token or user JWT; provider permissions apply. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="BASEROW CREATE-ROWS", and $retries=0. One request only. next/previous URLs are return-only metadata; choose page/size explicitly. No sign-in, token refresh, automatic retries, attachment downloads, webhooks or background listeners. Exact decimal text remains text; noninteger/unsafe JSON numeric tokens become exact source strings. Total deadline starts before profile/secret access; limits 200 rows per page/batch, 1 MiB response, 16384 nonempty chunks, 512 KiB request, depth 35. Known resource projection omits unsupported provider fields. Sources: https://baserow.io/docs/apis/rest-api https://api.baserow.io/api/schema.json https://api.baserow.io/api/redoc/ https://baserow.io/user-docs/database-api

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

PATCH {endpoint}/api/database/rows/table/{tableId}/batch/. Authentication: database Token or user JWT; provider permissions apply. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="BASEROW UPDATE-ROWS", and $retries=0. One request only. next/previous URLs are return-only metadata; choose page/size explicitly. No sign-in, token refresh, automatic retries, attachment downloads, webhooks or background listeners. Exact decimal text remains text; noninteger/unsafe JSON numeric tokens become exact source strings. Total deadline starts before profile/secret access; limits 200 rows per page/batch, 1 MiB response, 16384 nonempty chunks, 512 KiB request, depth 35. Known resource projection omits unsupported provider fields. Sources: https://baserow.io/docs/apis/rest-api https://api.baserow.io/api/schema.json https://api.baserow.io/api/redoc/ https://baserow.io/user-docs/database-api

definitions.documentation:
POST {endpoint}/api/database/rows/table/{tableId}/batch-delete/. Authentication: database Token or user JWT; provider permissions apply. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="BASEROW DELETE-ROWS", and $retries=0. One request only. next/previous URLs are return-only metadata; choose page/size explicitly. No sign-in, token refresh, automatic retries, attachment downloads, webhooks or background listeners. Exact decimal text remains text; noninteger/unsafe JSON numeric tokens become exact source strings. Total deadline starts before profile/secret access; limits 200 rows per page/batch, 1 MiB response, 16384 nonempty chunks, 512 KiB request, depth 35. Known resource projection omits unsupported provider fields. Sources: https://baserow.io/docs/apis/rest-api https://api.baserow.io/api/schema.json https://api.baserow.io/api/redoc/ https://baserow.io/user-docs/database-api

definitions.name: Baserow List Views (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
GET {endpoint}/api/database/views/table/{tableId}/. Authentication: user JWT only; provider permissions apply. One request only. next/previous URLs are return-only metadata; choose page/size explicitly. No sign-in, token refresh, automatic retries, attachment downloads, webhooks or background listeners. Exact decimal text remains text; noninteger/unsafe JSON numeric tokens become exact source strings. Total deadline starts before profile/secret access; limits 200 rows per page/batch, 1 MiB response, 16384 nonempty chunks, 512 KiB request, depth 35. Known resource projection omits unsupported provider fields. Sources: https://baserow.io/docs/apis/rest-api https://api.baserow.io/api/schema.json https://api.baserow.io/api/redoc/ https://baserow.io/user-docs/database-api

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Baserow Get View (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
GET {endpoint}/api/database/views/{viewId}/. Authentication: user JWT only; provider permissions apply. One request only. next/previous URLs are return-only metadata; choose page/size explicitly. No sign-in, token refresh, automatic retries, attachment downloads, webhooks or background listeners. Exact decimal text remains text; noninteger/unsafe JSON numeric tokens become exact source strings. Total deadline starts before profile/secret access; limits 200 rows per page/batch, 1 MiB response, 16384 nonempty chunks, 512 KiB request, depth 35. Known resource projection omits unsupported provider fields. Sources: https://baserow.io/docs/apis/rest-api https://api.baserow.io/api/schema.json https://api.baserow.io/api/redoc/ https://baserow.io/user-docs/database-api

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Baserow Create Grid View (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
POST {endpoint}/api/database/views/table/{tableId}/. Authentication: user JWT only; provider permissions apply. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="BASEROW CREATE-GRID-VIEW", and $retries=0. One request only. next/previous URLs are return-only metadata; choose page/size explicitly. No sign-in, token refresh, automatic retries, attachment downloads, webhooks or background listeners. Exact decimal text remains text; noninteger/unsafe JSON numeric tokens become exact source strings. Total deadline starts before profile/secret access; limits 200 rows per page/batch, 1 MiB response, 16384 nonempty chunks, 512 KiB request, depth 35. Known resource projection omits unsupported provider fields. Sources: https://baserow.io/docs/apis/rest-api https://api.baserow.io/api/schema.json https://api.baserow.io/api/redoc/ https://baserow.io/user-docs/database-api

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Baserow Update View (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
PATCH {endpoint}/api/database/views/{viewId}/. Authentication: user JWT only; provider permissions apply. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="BASEROW UPDATE-VIEW", and $retries=0. One request only. next/previous URLs are return-only metadata; choose page/size explicitly. No sign-in, token refresh, automatic retries, attachment downloads, webhooks or background listeners. Exact decimal text remains text; noninteger/unsafe JSON numeric tokens become exact source strings. Total deadline starts before profile/secret access; limits 200 rows per page/batch, 1 MiB response, 16384 nonempty chunks, 512 KiB request, depth 35. Known resource projection omits unsupported provider fields. Sources: https://baserow.io/docs/apis/rest-api https://api.baserow.io/api/schema.json https://api.baserow.io/api/redoc/ https://baserow.io/user-docs/database-api

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

endpoint.description: Required HTTPS origin, for example https://api.baserow.io; self-hosted HTTPS origins supported.

definitions.name: Baserow Delete View (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
DELETE {endpoint}/api/database/views/{viewId}/. Authentication: user JWT only; provider permissions apply. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="BASEROW DELETE-VIEW", and $retries=0. One request only. next/previous URLs are return-only metadata; choose page/size explicitly. No sign-in, token refresh, automatic retries, attachment downloads, webhooks or background listeners. Exact decimal text remains text; noninteger/unsafe JSON numeric tokens become exact source strings. Total deadline starts before profile/secret access; limits 200 rows per page/batch, 1 MiB response, 16384 nonempty chunks, 512 KiB request, depth 35. Known resource projection omits unsupported provider fields. Sources: https://baserow.io/docs/apis/rest-api https://api.baserow.io/api/schema.json https://api.baserow.io/api/redoc/ https://baserow.io/user-docs/database-api

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Baserow Get View Filter (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
GET {endpoint}/api/database/views/filter/{itemId}/. Authentication: user JWT only; provider permissions apply. One request only. next/previous URLs are return-only metadata; choose page/size explicitly. No sign-in, token refresh, automatic retries, attachment downloads, webhooks or background listeners. Exact decimal text remains text; noninteger/unsafe JSON numeric tokens become exact source strings. Total deadline starts before profile/secret access; limits 200 rows per page/batch, 1 MiB response, 16384 nonempty chunks, 512 KiB request, depth 35. Known resource projection omits unsupported provider fields. Sources: https://baserow.io/docs/apis/rest-api https://api.baserow.io/api/schema.json https://api.baserow.io/api/redoc/ https://baserow.io/user-docs/database-api

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Baserow Create View Filter (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
POST {endpoint}/api/database/views/{viewId}/filters/. Authentication: user JWT only; provider permissions apply. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="BASEROW CREATE-VIEW-FILTER", and $retries=0. One request only. next/previous URLs are return-only metadata; choose page/size explicitly. No sign-in, token refresh, automatic retries, attachment downloads, webhooks or background listeners. Exact decimal text remains text; noninteger/unsafe JSON numeric tokens become exact source strings. Total deadline starts before profile/secret access; limits 200 rows per page/batch, 1 MiB response, 16384 nonempty chunks, 512 KiB request, depth 35. Known resource projection omits unsupported provider fields. Sources: https://baserow.io/docs/apis/rest-api https://api.baserow.io/api/schema.json https://api.baserow.io/api/redoc/ https://baserow.io/user-docs/database-api

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

PATCH {endpoint}/api/database/views/filter/{itemId}/. Authentication: user JWT only; provider permissions apply. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="BASEROW UPDATE-VIEW-FILTER", and $retries=0. One request only. next/previous URLs are return-only metadata; choose page/size explicitly. No sign-in, token refresh, automatic retries, attachment downloads, webhooks or background listeners. Exact decimal text remains text; noninteger/unsafe JSON numeric tokens become exact source strings. Total deadline starts before profile/secret access; limits 200 rows per page/batch, 1 MiB response, 16384 nonempty chunks, 512 KiB request, depth 35. Known resource projection omits unsupported provider fields. Sources: https://baserow.io/docs/apis/rest-api https://api.baserow.io/api/schema.json https://api.baserow.io/api/redoc/ https://baserow.io/user-docs/database-api

definitions.name: Baserow Get View Sort (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
GET {endpoint}/api/database/views/sort/{itemId}/. Authentication: user JWT only; provider permissions apply. One request only. next/previous URLs are return-only metadata; choose page/size explicitly. No sign-in, token refresh, automatic retries, attachment downloads, webhooks or background listeners. Exact decimal text remains text; noninteger/unsafe JSON numeric tokens become exact source strings. Total deadline starts before profile/secret access; limits 200 rows per page/batch, 1 MiB response, 16384 nonempty chunks, 512 KiB request, depth 35. Known resource projection omits unsupported provider fields. Sources: https://baserow.io/docs/apis/rest-api https://api.baserow.io/api/schema.json https://api.baserow.io/api/redoc/ https://baserow.io/user-docs/database-api

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.documentation:
POST {endpoint}/api/database/views/{viewId}/sortings/. Authentication: user JWT only; provider permissions apply. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="BASEROW CREATE-VIEW-SORT", and $retries=0. One request only. next/previous URLs are return-only metadata; choose page/size explicitly. No sign-in, token refresh, automatic retries, attachment downloads, webhooks or background listeners. Exact decimal text remains text; noninteger/unsafe JSON numeric tokens become exact source strings. Total deadline starts before profile/secret access; limits 200 rows per page/batch, 1 MiB response, 16384 nonempty chunks, 512 KiB request, depth 35. Known resource projection omits unsupported provider fields. Sources: https://baserow.io/docs/apis/rest-api https://api.baserow.io/api/schema.json https://api.baserow.io/api/redoc/ https://baserow.io/user-docs/database-api
